faq.title: Common questions

setup.a: We set up your branches, class types, instructors and packages together on the first call. After you add your students you can take attendance the same day.

devices.q: Which devices does it work on?
devices.a: Phones, tablets and computers, in the browser. There is no app to install.

students.a: No. Your studio team uses StudioDesk; students only appear in your records.

data.a: Each studio’s data is kept separate and is visible only to your authorised team. It is stored on servers in the EU (Frankfurt) and travels over encrypted connections.

branches.q: I have several branches. Is one account enough?
branches.a: Yes. All branches are run from one account; timetables, rooms and the cash register are kept per branch.

price.a: Plans and prices are listed above. Setup with us is included in every plan, and for larger studios we can prepare a custom quote.
